techniques.name: Return
techniques.effect: When you take the Get Up action you may try to beat DV 13. On a success Get Up costs no action.

entries.name: Aikido
entries.summary: A soft style: blocks and disarms, turning the opponent's force against them.

techniques.name: Disarm
techniques.condition: This turn you hit one target with Brawling and with Martial Arts.
techniques.effect: Once per turn. On a success the item in the target's hands ends up in yours or falls to the floor.

techniques.name: Iron Grip
techniques.condition: The target is successfully grabbed and not yet under Iron Grip.
techniques.effect: An action, once per turn. On a success the target has a harder time breaking free: −2 to every attempt. While grabbed the target cannot make ranged attacks.

entries.name: Karate
entries.summary: A hard style: strikes that break bones and armor.

techniques.name: Break Armor
techniques.condition: This turn you hit one target with a melee weapon and with Martial Arts.
techniques.effect: Once per turn. On a success all of the target's armor is lowered by a further 2 points.

techniques.name: Bone Crusher
techniques.effect: Instead of two Martial Arts attacks: one attack on a target. On a hit the target also gets the critical injury Broken Ribs, in addition to damage (not added if it already has it). With a −8 penalty to the check (declared before the roll) the blow goes to the head like an aimed shot: on a success the target gets Cracked Skull after damage is counted (not added if it already has it).

entries.name: Judo
entries.summary: A soft style: grapples, throws and dodges.

techniques.name: Counter Throw
techniques.condition: You dodged every melee attack made against you since your last turn.
techniques.effect: An action, once per turn. On a success you use Throw on one of the targets whose melee attacks you dodged. It cannot be dodged and needs no grab.

techniques.name: Escape Hold
techniques.condition: This turn you made 2 melee attacks on the opponent who is grappling you.
techniques.effect: Once per turn. On a success you break free and the opponent gets the critical injury Broken Arm. If they had none, you choose the arm.

entries.name: Taekwondo
entries.summary: A hard style: high, precise kicks at pressure points.

techniques.name: Pressure Point Strike
techniques.effect: Instead of two Martial Arts attacks: one attack on a target at close range. On a hit the target also gets the critical injury Spinal Injury, in addition to damage (not added if it already has it). With a −8 penalty to the check (declared before the roll) the blow goes to the head like an aimed shot: on a success the target gets Brain Injury (not added if it already has it).

techniques.name: Flying Kick
techniques.condition: MOVE 8 or more. This turn you moved at least 4 m.
techniques.effect: Instead of two Martial Arts attacks: a rush in a straight line at a target up to 4 m away; no more movement this turn. On a hit damage is as for a Martial Arts attack, the target falls prone and is thrown off a motorcycle or any vehicle without a fully enclosed cabin.
